hypotheses.construction_plan: Replace the single parameter theta in the diagonal template M(theta, theta) by 1 or 2 to produce the corresponding member.
required_assumptions: M is a symbolic bivariate function and substitution into its arguments is structural.
hypotheses.rationale: The two M calls share the same function M applied along the diagonal, so a one-parameter diagonal template explains the observed substitution family without forming a compact final expression.
